scope: Five exact semantic declarations only; not full TR-27 or Comparator verification

NLA.TR27.finite_coordinates.signature: [FiniteDimensional ℂ W] : ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (W ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Fin n → ℂ))

NLA.TR27.tensor_representatives.signature: (x y : W) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y ≠ 0 ∧ ∃! q : ℙ ℂ (W ⊗[ℂ] W), Represents (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) q

NLA.TR27.cone_projective_membership.signature: (X : ProjectiveVariety W) (hX : X.Admissible) (v : W) (hv : v ≠ 0) : Projectivization.mk ℂ v hv ∈ X.points ↔ v ∈ X.cone

NLA.TR27.projective_cone_rank.signature: (X : ProjectiveVariety W) (hX : X.Admissible) (r : ℕ) (v : W) (hv : v ≠ 0) : ProjectiveRankAtMost X.points r (Projectivization.mk ℂ v hv) ↔ ConeRankAtMost X.cone r v

NLA.TR27.rank_minima.signature: (X : ProjectiveVariety W) (hX : X.Admissible) (p : ℙ ℂ W) : (∃ r, ProjectiveRankAtMost X.points r p) ∧ (∀ r, ProjectiveRankAtMost X.points r p ↔ projectiveRank X.points p ≤ r) ∧ (∃ r, p ∈ X.zariskiClosure {q | ProjectiveRankAtMost X.points r q}) ∧ (∀ r, p ∈ X.zariskiClosure {q | ProjectiveRankAtMost X.points r q} ↔ borderRank X p ≤ r)
